d: The Senior Compliance officer is responsible of carrying out detailed analysis, review and report on the end-to-end different processes on SAP in accordance with policies, procedures, industry best practices.
q: li
Relevant working experience, in compliance, risk & internal audit.
li
Knowledge, understanding and experience in the stated field processes, fraud and / or compliance.
li
Knowledge and understanding in risk and compliance management.
li
Knowledge and understanding on planning, material master data, material consumption, inventory management, etc.
li
Knowledge and understanding of vendor sourcing and management.
li
Knowledge of logistics and warehousing management.
li
Knowledge and understanding of Primavera and SAP systems which includes planning.
li
Demonstrated skills in MS Office Suites, presentation, communication (verbal and written) and analysis.
r: li
Identify areas of compliance – company policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, etc.
li
Conduct functional analyses and reviews on Cost Control to identify areas of non-compliance and advise mitigations to address non-compliance.
li
Investigate reports with compliance issues, irregularities, and violations.
li
Communicate non-compliance with respective departments and ensure corrective actions are complied with.
li
Ensure tracking tools are maintained and that these are sufficient to act as an audit trail for the purposes of internal or other audits/investigations.
li
Advise and create process and system improvements based on investigations and observations.
li
Monitor standards that ensure that all records and documents are maintained according to policies and procedures.
li
Follow up on recommendations for non-compliance in relation to the timeframe for implementation.
li
Monitor performance by updating performance scorecard issuance monthly.
li
Plan and coordinate training on compliance matters as required and recommended.
li

Notify policy custodians (through official channels) of any suggested changes to improve policies and procedures. Review new draft policies and procedures to identify significant compliance weaknesses.
li
Keep updated on changes in regulations, legislation, policies and procedures that may affect the organization and compliance reviews.

d: Role Description The VP of Leadership Development is a full-time, remote role responsible for designing, leading, and continuously improving enterprise-wide leadership development initiatives. This role oversees the creation of frameworks, programs, and learning experiences that build leadership capabilities at all levels, including emerging leaders, mid-level leaders, and senior executives. Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing organizational leadership needs, setting strategy and priorities for leadership development, and collaborating with HR, business leaders, and key stakeholders to align programs with business goals. The VP will lead the design and delivery of training curricula, coaching programs, and succession planning processes, while measuring impact through defined metrics and reporting outcomes to executive leadership. This role also involves managing vendors and internal teams, overseeing budgets, ensuring inclusive and equitable development opportunities, and staying current with best practices and innovations in leadership and organizational development.
q: li
Leadership Development, Training – Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and oversee comprehensive leadership development and training programs at scale.
li
Needs Analysis, Consulting – Strong skills in assessing organizational needs, conducting gap analyses, and providing strategic consulting to senior leaders.
li
Succession Planning – Experience building and managing succession planning frameworks, talent pipelines, and high-potential development strategies.
li
Strategic Planning and Change Management – Proven capability to create long-term development roadmaps, support organizational change, and align initiatives with business objectives.
li
Data-Driven Decision Making – Ability to define success metrics, analyze program effectiveness, and use data to refine leadership development strategies.
li
Inclusive Leadership and DEI Mindset – Commitment to equitable, accessible leadership development that supports diverse talent and fosters inclusive culture.
li
Communication and Stakeholder Management – Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing and partnering with senior leaders.
li
Team Leadership – Experience leading cross-functional teams, managing external partners, and overseeing budgets for development initiatives.
li

Education and Experience – Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, HR, Business, Psychology, or related field preferred. Significant experience in senior leadership, organizational development, or talent management roles.
